title: Restructure the Test evidence bullets in engram-host-adapter.md into sub-bullets per rule
outcome: Round-15 and round-17 reviews (Claude, tm-winf steps 2+3). The Test evidence section of docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md packs many interacting rules into very long single bullets (Which worktree, Overlap), which makes the contract hard to audit against the code and to update. Split into sub-bullets or a table per rule (recognition, crediting, shell tracking, overlap sources, outcome, freshness), naming the owning functions (engram_check_recognition.rs, engram_check_paths.rs, engram_turn_checks.rs).
